channel.description: Resources Slides Video Script [00:00] Hello and welcome to the week 8 announcements video for CIS 527 and CC 510 in fall 2026. So coming up, we’ve got the discussion to response that’s due pretty soon this week, so make sure you get that turned in and updated. I believe that’s due on Thursday. The Lab 4 quizzes are due on Friday. Next week on Wednesday, we have our third discussion session, which I’ll talk about briefly. And then at the end of that week, Lab 4 is due. So you should hopefully be starting on Lab 4 soon.
